title: ppGpp pool over the cell cycle (all seeds)
interpretation: ppGpp concentration trajectories for all 4 seeds. Starts ~30 uM, rises to a steady ~60-70 uM band -- the alarmone pool the ppgpp_regulation subsystem (default-on) maintains at this growth rate. x-axis in minutes.
command: v2ecoli native analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/) over .pbg/runs/showcase2-baseline/sweep/showcase2_baseline parquet; rendered to PNG via vl_convert/matplotlib on the mac mini
